title: ANSSI's second REACTIV report details October data leaks across French state bodies
what_changed: Plain text said 64 leaks were at public bodies; the report says 64 new breaches reached ANSSI since September 30, of which five concern ministries or their agencies. France Travail 'second factor bypassed' reworded to the report's wording (compromised agent account, with SMS second-factor validation).
